::: {#rem-slr-parameters}
#### Interpreting the parameters

- $\intcoef = \mean(0)$ is the **intercept**:
  the mean of $Y$ among observations with $X = 0$.
- $\coef{x} = \mean(x + 1) - \mean(x)$ is the **slope**:
  the difference in the mean of $Y$
  between two groups whose values of $X$ differ by one unit.
- $\varpar$ is the variance of $Y$ around its mean at each value of $X$.
:::
